Libraries and Packages
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
SurveyResponses <- read_excel("SurveyResponses.xlsx")
View(SurveyResponses)

#Summary of all variables
summary(SurveyResponses)

#Frequency tables
table(SurveyResponses$Gender)
table(SurveyResponses$`Age Group`)
table(SurveyResponses$`Health Insurance`)
table(SurveyResponses$`Healthcare Checkup`)
table(SurveyResponses$`Sexual Behaviors`)
table(SurveyResponses$`Positive STI Test`)
table(SurveyResponses$`Housing Situation`)
table(SurveyResponses$Cost)

#Cross tabs
table(SurveyResponses$Gender, SurveyResponses$`Healthcare Checkup`)
table(SurveyResponses$`Health Insurance`, SurveyResponses$`Healthcare Checkup`)
table(SurveyResponses$Gender, SurveyResponses$`Health Insurance`)
table(SurveyResponses$`Sexual Behaviors`, SurveyResponses$`Positive STI Test`)

#Chi square tests
tbl_gender_checkup <- table(SurveyResponses$Gender,SurveyResponses$`Healthcare Checkup`)
chisq.test(tbl_gender_checkup)

tbl_insurance_checkup <- table(SurveyResponses$`Health Insurance`,SurveyResponses$`Healthcare Checkup`)
chisq.test(tbl_insurance_checkup)

tbl_behavior_sti <- table(SurveyResponses$`Sexual Behaviors`,SurveyResponses$`Positive STI Test`)
chisq.test(tbl_behavior_sti)

#Logistic regression
SurveyResponses <- SurveyResponses %>%
  mutate(
    willingness_test_numeric = case_when(
      `WillingnessTest` == "Definitely Willing" ~ 5,
      `WillingnessTest` == "Probably Willing" ~ 4,
      `WillingnessTest` == "Unsure" ~ 3,
      `WillingnessTest` == "Probably Not Willing" ~ 2,
      `WillingnessTest` == "Definitely Not Willing" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    willingness_test_paid_numeric = case_when(
      `WillingnessTestPaid` == "Definitely Willing" ~ 5,
      `WillingnessTestPaid` == "Probably Willing" ~ 4,
      `WillingnessTestPaid` == "Unsure" ~ 3,
      `WillingnessTestPaid` == "Probably Not Willing" ~ 2,
      `WillingnessTestPaid` == "Definitely Not Willing" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

#Models
lm_will <- lm(
  willingness_test_numeric ~ `Sexual Behaviors`,
  data = SurveyResponses
)
summary(lm_will)


lm_paid <- lm(
  willingness_test_paid_numeric ~ `Sexual Behaviors`,
  data = SurveyResponses
)
summary(lm_paid)
```
